verdict.rationale: The evidence says Whisper is multilingual, that a language can be specified (e.g. Japanese), and that some model sizes have English-only versions. It never shows a published, concrete list of supported languages, and it does not state per-model or per-feature language differences beyond the English-only variants. The core of the story, a concrete language list, is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, the supported languages are published as a concrete list, with any per-model or per-feature differences stated
